scope: Sources actually adapted into this repository and direct runtime packages exercised in the local acceptance environment. Research candidates are recorded separately in docs/upstream-sources.json.

adapted_sources.adaptation: Selectively adapted disclosure-to-section mapping and claim/embodiment/figure consistency review as a text writing method, and vendored the unmodified Word conversion tools (md_to_docx/math_to_omml/latex_delimiters/stdio_utf8/emit_application_docx) for the opt-in `--renderer upstream` path. Local adapter only projects PatentDraft to upstream Markdown, applies the project A4/black-font/margin layout at the boundary, and rejects missing images, raw-LaTeX formula fallback and bare-paren LaTeX. No directory/YAML protocol, fixed prior-art counts or upstream delivery policies imported, and the default renderer is unchanged.
adapted_sources.verification: Pinned source bytes and MIT license checked by tests/test_patent_upstream_render.py at every run (SHA256); 4 synthetic cases (plain, math+table, figure+long, utility) generated and 17 pages rendered/visually inspected with LibreOffice 26.8; negative cases rejected. No Word/WPS editing round-trip, complex-formula or filing acceptance.
